questions.q: True or false? Our shape is three defenders, two midfielders and three forwards, plus the goalkeeper.
questions.explain: Right, it's true. Three-two-three counts the eight outfield players, and the goalkeeper is counted separately.
choiceExplanations: Right, it's true. Three-two-three counts the eight outfield players, and the goalkeeper is counted separately.
Count the units again: three at the back, two in the middle, three up front, plus the goalkeeper.

questions.q: Put the left defender's advance in order.
options: Goalkeeper passes to the left defender
Left defender carries the ball forward
Center defender slides left, behind the ball
Left defender returns to reset the shape
questions.explain: Yes. The pass comes first, then the carry, then cover slides behind, then the shape resets.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The pass comes first, then the carry, then cover slides behind, then the shape resets.
The left defender can only carry forward after the goalkeeper's pass arrives.
The center defender slides across once the left defender has moved forward and left space behind.
We reset only after the advance, when the left defender brings the ball back.

questions.q: The left defender carries even further forward. Drag the center defender to support.
questions.explain: Right. Sliding left behind the ball covers the space and gives a safe pass back.
choiceExplanations: Joining the same run leaves nobody behind the ball, so one lost pass is dangerous.
